walls.note: The 39.3 m BAG wall is the brick front on the Sarphatistraat (Weesperplein end): a four-storey east part (a -11.9..15.4 m) and the five-storey west part (a -23.9..-11.9). The tower stands 7.6 m behind it (its north face at b -7.2 rises above the 16.3 m brick roof) and is listed here too, from the same crops and far view recording_2025-06-19_03-28-47_03532 (2025-06-19). The curved entrance drum at the east end of this front has no brief wall (its BAG facets are < 4 m); it is listed here from TMX7316010203-002825_pano_0003_001362 (2022-10-07) and recording_2025-06-19_03-28-47_03191 (2025-06-19).
